name: One list, one shortcut row
summary: Cut the page down to three things: a sentence that says what is in the file, one row of shortcut chips built from the file (its biggest employers, its own tags, recent connections, places, roles), and a two-pane view where the globe lights the selection and a single People list shows who is behind it. Every shortcut, search, answer and click sets the same selection. It only lights people and never rebuilds the globe. Fixed VC lenses, duplicate controls and empty presets are removed.

networkProfile:
Profile the file once, on the client, from the deduped contacts; nothing is sent to a server. Let n be the number of contacts.
- hasTags: at least 50% of rows have tags or more.
- hasPlace: at least 50% of rows have a location.
- hasDates: at least 50% of rows have connectedOn.
- hasCompanies: at least 50% of rows have a company. When it is false (an X import), the company shortcuts and the company sentence are skipped.
- companies: groupByCompany(contacts) with the no-company bucket left out. This gives whole-network totals, never atlas slices.
- city(c): the text before the first comma of location, trimmed. Count these values.
- recent: contacts whose connectedOn falls within the 365 days before the newest connectedOn in the file. Anchoring on the file, not the clock, keeps tests stable.
- roles: classifyContact, after two required fixes in roles.js. First, tags are never tested against title regexes. Second, a company-only hit for investor or clinician does not count when the contact has a non-empty title that did not match; such a contact is classified again without the company. Specific roles are those with a plural label (investor, lp, founder, clinician, academic, banker, lawyer, consultant, student, public, press, accelerator). Executive, operator, professional, partner and other are generic and never become shortcuts.
- senior: seniority(c) === 0.
- Default grouping: role, unless the largest role group is over 70% of n. Then use country if hasPlace, otherwise industry. Result: the LP list opens by country (United States 61, France 11, United Kingdom 11 and so on) and every other sample opens by role.
- Grouping options shown: only those whose buckets split the file, meaning at least 2 buckets of 5% or more each and a largest bucket of 90% or less. Country is hidden on all LinkedIn files, where 100% are Unknown.

presets.label: Tagged “{tag}” · {n}
presets.when: hasTags; the tags ranked by count, each with n of 3 or more and 80% of contacts or fewer; at most 3
presets.action: Toggle. Selection = everyone who carries that tag (exact, case-insensitive tag match, never a title). The globe gets highlightIds of those person ids (no atlas rebuild), and the camera fits the lit people. The People panel is titled “Tagged {tag} · {n}”. The summary and dashboard are unchanged. Pressing the chip again clears.
presets.why: CRM and LP files already carry the user's own pipeline (customer, prospect, committed, warm); this is the most actionable axis and no control uses it today.

presets.label: At {company} · {n}
presets.when: hasCompanies; whole-network groupByCompany, each with n ≥ max(3, ceil(2% of contacts)); the top 2
presets.action: Toggle. Selection = all people at that company, whatever the grouping, so Stripe lights 22 even though it is split 10+11+1 across role branches. Camera: if every lit person shares one company node, focus that node; otherwise fit the lit people. Panel “At {company} · {n}”, with the company actions (Company profile, Intro paths to {company}) in the panel header. Pressing the chip again clears.
presets.why: Replaces “Largest company”, which flew to an atlas slice (Google 12), never named the company and changed nothing visible on a second press.

presets.label: {Role plural} · {n}
presets.when: specific roles (after the two classification fixes) with n ≥ 3 and between 5% and 70% of contacts; the top 2
presets.action: Toggle. Selection = contacts with that role. Highlight only, with the camera fitting the lit people. Panel “{Role plural} · {n}”, each row showing classifyContact.reason as its why-line.
presets.why: Says who is actually in this file (Clinicians, Researchers, LPs) instead of the fixed VC lenses, which matched 71-98% of the file.

presets.label: Connected in the past year · {n}
presets.action: Toggle. Selection = recent (365 days before the newest date in the file), highlighted. The panel is sorted newest first and each row shows “Connected {Mon YYYY}”.
presets.why: Fresh ties are the warmest asks; the date column is in every LinkedIn export and nothing uses it today.

presets.label: In {city} · {n}
presets.when: hasPlace and the top city has n ≥ 3 and ≤ 60% of contacts; only the top 1
presets.action: Toggle. Selection = contacts whose city(c) equals it (case-insensitive), highlighted. Panel “In {city} · {n}”.
presets.why: Answers “who can I meet when I'm there” for CRM, clinical and LP lists.

presets.label: Senior leaders · {n}
presets.when: senior count between 5% and 60% of contacts; shown only if fewer than 6 chips are already filled
presets.action: Toggle. Selection = seniority 0 (founders, CEOs, chiefs, partners, principals), highlighted. Panel “Senior leaders · {n}”.
presets.why: A one-press decision-maker list. It replaces the seniority bar in the dashboard.

labelsAndGroupings:
Shortcut row: chips are ordered tag, company, role, recent, place, senior, at most 6. A chip with a count of 0 is never rendered. Chip labels use only names and tag text from the file.

Selection model: at most one active selection at a time, from a chip, the Find box, an answer, or a clicked group, company or person. Choosing one replaces the previous. Each selection has a kind, a label and a Set of person ids, and it drives highlightIds. The panel title is always "{label} · {count}" with an x that clears it. Clear (and Fit) returns to "Everyone · n" at the root.

Group labels: keep the canonical role-group names, but drop the VC hint sentences. When one specific role makes up 95% or more of a group, the group is labelled with that role's plural instead. For example, the LP list's investors bubble does not appear because the file opens by country.

Lenses: the Raise, Source and Diligence preset buttons and the three dashboard gauges are removed. The lens survives only inside the question engine. Lens counts filter nothing (Source matched 499 of 544 in the VC file), returned 0 for Raise on the healthcare file, and matched everyone on the LP list.

Grouping switch: it becomes a small "Arrange by" select listing only the groupings that split the file. "By company" stays only once atlas tops are capped at 16 plus "Other companies", like MAX_HUBS. Today it takes 10-32 s on the samples.

Example questions: see questions.
layout:
Order: map card first (summary, shortcuts, ask, globe + People), then answers render IN the People panel, then the one-line sources strip, then Founder checks.
Removed: the "Zoom to" bar (its children become clickable group rows at the top of the People panel); the Layers steps and the back chip (the breadcrumb is the only location indicator); the Whole network preset and the "All" crumb duplicate (Fit = clear + root); Raise/Source/Diligence presets and gauges; Largest company; the seniority bar (now the Senior leaders chip and the default sort); the panel's separate lens state; the dead companyFilter; the rotating 3.5s placeholder animation (static data-built placeholder; examples show in the dropdown on focus).
Merged: Find box + "Filter these people" become one "Find" input at the top of the People panel. It filters the list and lights matches only after 2 or more characters. Ask stays separate because it understands sentences.
Moved: the answer leaves the bottom of the page. It becomes a selection: panel title "Answer · {total}", a one-line summary, rows with reasons, and the intro paths section under it. The Sources card collapses to one line under the map, with the four connector cards only behind "Add file".
Details panel: a clicked person opens inline in the list row (expand), so the list never disappears.
Fixes required: Remove all must not call setExpanded; inline hex colours must become tokens; arbitrary text sizes must become scale tokens.
questions:
Build up to 4 examples. Each is used only when the needed field exists and the predicted count is greater than 0:
1. "Who do I know at {top company}?"
2. "Intro paths to {second company}". Shown only when hasCompanies.
3. "Who is in {top city}?" when hasPlace. Otherwise "Who did I connect with in the past year?". The second needs a date filter added to query.js, or it is answered on the client from recent; until then this example is skipped.
4. "Which {top role plural, lower} do I know at {company with most of that role}?"

Never use a map industry label in an example: query.js drops them. Store the examples in place of EXAMPLES at line 56. The placeholder is example 1. When the dropdown is open on focus, it lists all of them.
examples:

acceptance: buildShortcuts(profile) on vc-investor-linkedin.csv returns exactly [At Stripe·22, At Google·19, Investors·106, Founders·78, Connected in the past year·83, Senior leaders·201]; on sales-crm.csv the first three are the tags prospect 107, customer 73, partner 69 and no chip names investors
No shortcut chip ever renders with a count of 0, on any of the six fixtures
On lp-fundraising-list.csv the Investors chip shows 32 and there is no LPs chip (82 is over 70%); the default grouping is country

Pressing At Stripe under role grouping sets highlightIds to exactly 22 person ids and leaves the atlas object identity unchanged (no rebuild); the panel title reads 'At Stripe · 22'; pressing it again restores 'Everyone · 544'
Pressing a chip while an answer is shown replaces the answer selection; only one chip is ever aria-pressed
classifyContact on a sales-crm row with tag 'partner' and title 'Chief Executive Officer' returns group founders, not investors; a 'Software Engineer' at '* Capital' is not an investor
The page contains no Raise capital, Source deals, Diligence or Largest company control, no Zoom to bar and no Layers steps
Country is not offered in Arrange by for any LinkedIn fixture; By company is either absent or builds in under 200 ms on vc-investor (capped tops)
The example questions on healthcare-academic.csv mention Massachusetts General Hospital and never Google or Stripe; each example run through query.js returns at least 1 result
Remove all empties the list with no error notice
After an upload the viewport top is the map card, and the summary sentence is the first text in it
grep finds no hex colour literals or text-[..px] classes in network.js
risks:
- The role chips depend on the two classification fixes. Without them the CRM shows 69 false investors and the founder file shows 73. The clinician vocabulary also lacks Cardiologist.
- Tag chips trust the user's tag text exactly. Some tags are not stages (for example "met 2026"), but that is still the user's own word.
- Highlighting people spread over the globe more than 1.1 rad apart barely moves the camera. NetworkGraph needs fit-to-bounds (zoom out to root) for wide selections.
- Without a date filter, the recent example question and the recent filter in the Ask box need client-side handling.
- Dropping the lens presets removes a familiar VC entry point. The Ask box must still parse "raise", "source" and "diligence".
